title: Architectural Design Patterns for Edge and Generative AI
subtitle: A Pattern Language for Agentic, Distributed, Reliable and Secure AI Systems
publisherCandidates: Springer Nature Computer Science book program
distinctiveContribution: A research-oriented pattern language that connects generative AI, agentic control, distributed execution, evidence, security, resilience and Edge-Mesh-Cloud deployment through composable architectural patterns and explicit validation boundaries.

chapters.title: Pattern Languages for AI-Intensive Systems
chapters.originalContribution: Defines an AI-specific architectural pattern language, quality attributes, composition rules and research questions beyond the implementation catalog.

chapters.title: Agentic Control and Orchestration
chapters.originalContribution: Builds a control-plane model for agentic workflows and compares orchestration structures using explicit termination, evaluation and authority boundaries.

chapters.title: Tool Ecosystems and Model Context Protocol
chapters.originalContribution: Studies tool ecosystems as capability boundaries and relates MCP discovery, validation, sandboxing and sanitization to secure agent architecture.

chapters.title: Knowledge and Context Architectures
chapters.originalContribution: Introduces a compositional model for retrieval, grounding, compression, memory and attribution with measurable evidence and context-integrity properties.

chapters.title: Reasoning and Evaluator Architectures
chapters.originalContribution: Separates internal reasoning techniques from externally verifiable evaluator loops and proposes validation boundaries for claims of improved reasoning.

chapters.title: Multi-Agent Coordination
chapters.originalContribution: Develops coordination topologies, delegation contracts and shared-state models for multi-agent systems, including failure propagation and conflict handling.

chapters.title: Reliability and Resilience
chapters.originalContribution: Adapts distributed-systems resilience patterns to probabilistic AI components and defines failure containment, replay, rollback and recovery semantics.

chapters.title: Security and Safety by Architecture
chapters.originalContribution: Treats model output and tool use as untrusted inputs, composing preventive, detective and recovery controls into a defense-in-depth architecture.

chapters.title: Observability, Evaluation and FinOps
chapters.originalContribution: Defines cross-layer measurements for quality, latency, tokens, cost, regressions and experiment integrity so architectural choices can be falsified and compared.

chapters.title: Edge-Mesh-Cloud AI Architectures
chapters.originalContribution: Presents an original Edge-Mesh-Cloud composition model for placement, coordination, observability and graceful degradation under latency and resource constraints.

chapters.title: High-Dependability Vehicular and C-V2X Systems
chapters.originalContribution: Uses vehicular and C-V2X scenarios as a planned original research exemplar for latency, trust, delegation, recovery and distributed decision making.

chapters.title: Empirical Validation and Research Agenda
chapters.originalContribution: Defines benchmark design, ablations, adversarial evaluation, threats to validity and a reproducible research agenda for pattern-level and composition-level evidence.
